name: paragraph-lines-join
open: two lines of a paragraph typed on a page (`4` Enter `1`) save as one paragraph that reads back `4 1`: the line break becomes a space

name: empty-item-saved-as-text
open: a bare `1. ` typed on an empty page is saved as a note whose text is `(empty)`; a fresh load reads `1. (empty)`

name: task-without-dash
open: a task typed as `[ ] 1` stays `[ ] 1` in the editor but saves and reads back as `- [ ] 1` (the canonical form): a reopen changes the text

case.acts: key [; key space; key ]; key space; key 1

name: one-space-indent
open: a line left with one leading space (here: Del on `- agent alpha`'s dash) is held as ` agent alpha` but saves as a child and reads back indented two spaces

name: marker-in-front
open: a marker typed in front of another (`1. ` before `- alpha`) is held as `1. - alpha` but saves as `1. alpha`: the inner `- ` is dropped (the editor should show what it saved, or keep the text)

case.acts: key d-up; key 1; key .; key space

name: first-line-indent
open: Tab on the first item of a page (here ⌃T on an empty page, then Tab) indents it with nothing to nest under: held as `  - [ ] ` but saved at the top level. caretline's outline (0.3.0 headless) refuses that indent; thc's page editor should too

name: empty-link-not-saved
open: deleting a link's title (⌥⌦ inside `[[Garden]]`) leaves `see [[]]` in the editor, but the change never reaches the vault: a fresh load still reads `see [[Garden]]` (the save of a line with an empty link is dropped silently)

name: orphan-indent
open: a line left indented under nothing (here ⌘A, ⇧↑, ⌘⌫ deletes the lines above `  bank gamma`) stays indented in the editor but saves at the top level: the editor should outdent it as the vault does (writing.md: children move up)

case.acts: key d-a; key s-up; key d-bs

name: undo-not-taken-in
open: an agent marks a task done (the open page shows `[x]`), then `u` (undo the agent's change, from the toast) reopens it in the vault, but the page's editor still shows `[x]`: thc screen doesn't reload an open document after its own undo of an outside change (seen before with an agent's add and delete)

name: undo-restore-stale
open: an agent deletes a note (the open page drops its lines), then `u` (undo the agent's change) brings it back in the vault, but the page's editor doesn't show it again: the same as undo-not-taken-in (thc screen doesn't reload an open document after its own undo of an outside change)

name: agent-change-stale
open: an agent adds a note to the open page (the editor shows `- agent gamma`), then `u` (undo the agent's change) removes it from the vault, but the editor still shows it: thc screen doesn't reload an open document after its own undo (same family as undo-not-taken-in, undo-restore-stale)

name: token-read-on-save
open: a capture token on a page is read on save while the editor keeps what was typed, even half typed: Headless saves `x due:f` as `(empty)` (`due:f` read as Friday and taken out, `x ` as a box), and the pty, which saves after half a second, turns `Uj1 due:fri` into `- [ ] Uj1 due:2026-10-16`. A reopen reads differently; the editor could take in the saved form, or a page could leave tokens as text until the line is done

case.acts: key x; key space; key d; key u; key e; key :; key f; key r; key i; key space

name: log-row-not-replayable
open: the same acts on a fresh copy of the same vault (node and log ids derived) leave a different Log feed about 3 runs in 5: a multi-node delete's row names a different node (deleted nvkc4 garden gamma vs deleted nvkc2 milk see [[Garden]], +2 more). Something on the way (an agent's delete after U, the page's save lining lines up by text, or the Log's tx_main) depends on a HashMap's order
pattern: replays the same: the same acts on a fresh screen gave a different state

name: numbering-after-task-key
open: an empty task made with ⌃T on the blank line between `2.` and `3.` splits the list (CommonMark, and the vault: the item after it reads `1.` on a reopen), but the editor keeps `3.`: the renumbering doesn't run after ⌃T's edit (an editor-task command; thc's if it goes around fictty's edit path)

name: list-write-not-taken-in
open: a task turned off from the Tasks list (`t` on `[ ] beta`) changes the vault, but a document the screen already loaded (Garden, opened next from Pages) still shows `- [ ] beta`: the host's own writes from a list don't reload the documents it has loaded (only a poll after outside news does)
